title: In Modem, there is a possible out of bounds write due to improper input validation. (CVE-2026-20549)
description: A vulnerability in the modem component allows for a possible out of bounds write due to improper input validation. This flaw could enable remote escalation of privilege if a user equipment (UE) connects to a rogue base station controlled by an attacker. Exploitation does not require additional execution privileges or user interaction.
